instruction: Please enable auto-save in VS Code settings.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling auto-save in VS Code. Evaluator reads settings.json and verifies the 'files.autoSave' setting is set to 'afterDelay' (the default auto-save mode).
metadata.verification: Verified that getter reads settings.json from VM and metric checks if files.autoSave equals 'afterDelay'. Added postconfig to close VS Code to ensure settings are saved.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VS Code settings.json from the standard location (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Metric correctly parses JSON and checks the 'files.autoSave' setting value
Postconfig appropriately kills VS Code to ensure settings are flushed to disk before verification
Metric correctly handles the 'rules' parameter (not 'expected') when expected.type='rule'

Expected value 'afterDelay' is semantically restrictive - VS Code has multiple auto-save modes ('afterDelay', 'onFocusChange', 'onWindowChange') that all enable auto-save, but evaluator only accepts 'afterDelay'
However, 'afterDelay' is the most common/default mode when enabling auto-save via UI, so this will work correctly in typical usage
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider accepting any non-'off' value for files.autoSave to properly verify that auto-save is enabled (not just checking for one specific mode)
Alternatively, update instruction to be more specific: 'Enable auto-save with afterDelay mode in VS Code settings' to match the restrictive expected value
